positions.title: Employment Brand Specialist
positions.description:
Curated content for Georgia Institute of Technology Human Resources social media accounts related to recruitment and branding

Supported in creating and producing printed recruiting materials, including flyers, signage, and slides

Captured and collected content to create graphically appealing and visually on-brand resources for recruitment and retention initiatives

Provided support for Georgia Tech Human Resources Communications Department, including graphic design, website updates, video production, document creation, and internal campaigns

Overhaul and maintain websites for small businesses and non-profits

Produce promotional videos

Oversee digital communication and create print pieces for local chamber music organization

Create social media ads (copy, graphics, scheduling)

positions.title: Marketing & Media | Public Relations Specialist
positions.description:
Designed, created, and organized print media

Prepared (research, write, etc.) various marketing communication pieces (news editorials, brochures, fliers, scripts, PSAs, social media content, and website updates, talking points, briefing papers) that informed stakeholders

Designed graphics and images and/or produced videos to accompany marketing communication pieces, where applicable

Conceptualized, implemented, and expanded brand strategy and visual identity elements (color palettes, typography, etc.)

Documented programs and accomplishments that aligned with the school's vision and mission through storytelling, photography, and videography to share with stakeholders via social media channels and community and online media outlets

Planned and executed all web and social media campaigns

Designed, built, and maintained the school's social media presence

Produced informational and promotional videos for various purposes/platforms (concept to post-production) for internal and external audiences

Secured and coordinated media coverage for major school events

Prepared written correspondence (speeches, remarks, etc.) for administrators for key events
positions.insights: Skills: Video Production · Digital Photography · Writing · Graphics Layout · Voiceovers · Digital Illustration · Graphic Design

positions.title: Digital Media Communications Manager
positions.description:
Assumed primary responsibility for all aspects of the school's website, including developing, managing, and maintaining the site

Oversaw the school's complete online presence, including social media, ensuring consistency with the objectives of the Office of Advancement and the school's strategic goals

Drove digital media programs through design, development, deployment, and ongoing management

Monitored industry trends and technologies; researching, recommending, and applying new technologies as they emerge

Coordinated filming of key school events

Created promotional videos that exemplified the Trinity experience and align with the objectives of the Office of Advancement

Worked with Instructional Technology Team to train and support website contributors

Created and distributed reports on website traffic and engagement

Managed digital media budget

Assisted Director of Marketing and Communications in development and execution of school publications as requested

Organized and distributed the school online weekly newsletter, "Trinity This Week"

Managed school-wide and large partnership events using online management tools (Eventbrite, SignUpGenius)

positions.title: Webmaster & Video Producer
positions.description:
Managed Trinity School's website, which serves the school's main vehicle for communication for students, Faculty, Staff, Board members, parents, alumni, and prospective families

Designed, implemented, and managed new website pages and components when requested

Managed login and directory information for all website users (~6,400 users)

Filmed and creatively shared school-wide events via web and DVD

Produced promotional videos

Monitored online payments, classroom web page content, conference schedules, handbooks, classroom blogs and wikis, etc.

Maintained, organized, and purged web files (photos, videos, documents, form submissions)

Assisted Director of Communications with preparation of broadcast emails

Developed tutorials and other training resources for website contributors
